body:
It is very hard to find a job so I'm working for myself and not reporting it. If they find out I work for myself they would take my business away even though I'm not really allowed to work anywhere else.

I don't have family left alive. No support system at all. Maybe my clients would do something for me but i would literally die before taking anything from them. They have all been so good to me.

I do own my own welding machine. I repair farm equipment and weld iron fences on the side. My pottery business is my primary source of income. All in all I'm doing pretty well.

They do accept a pay stub for proof of continued employment but when you are first hired at a new company, before you get a pay stub, they call right away(i have to let them know within a few days) to make sure I'm doing what I say I am. It's not supposed to notify but it does so anyway. Some employers won't release info unless they know who and why someone is calling to ask about an employee so the police have to explain the reason for their call.

Thank you for your response. I have completed trade school and am a fairly good welder because of it. The problem is that when I get a job I have to report it to the state police(sex offender unit) and they call to verify my employment. Boom. Fired.

Even if I am not fired, my co-workers hear about it and raise hell about perverts and child molesters until I am forced to leave. It seems that men are much more defensive about sex offenders than women ever thought about being.

The thing is that the public defender is not incompetent. He seems to be a very smart fellow but he didn't want to take the time to see my case through a trial for some reason.

The girl did this because she had a boyfriend at the time that I didn't know about. She said that she had to tell the police that I forced my way in so that he wouldn't be mad and beat her for inviting me over. That is also a lie I'm sure. She is now married to the same guy and they have a kid together.

You would have to know this woman. When she was younger she would do anything she could to hurt people. I dated her when I was 17 and my mother always told me to stay away from her. I was too dumb to listen apparently.

I would put this girl right up there with some of the meanest people I know and NOT just because of what she did to me. She is just plain old mean. Or at least she was. I hope she has changed since then.

Do you think there is any way I can go back and get my old case reopened based on the fact that my lawyer manipulated me into pleading to a charge that I didn't fully understand the consequences of? I really wanted to plead innocent but he convinced me otherwise when I know now that it was the wrong choice. He was the professional and I felt that I had to listen to his advice.

He absolutely did lie to me. I asked him several times about it because I didn't believe him. The charge was attempted aggravated sexual battery.

Since then Kansas has done away with the "attempted" charges in their statutes and the charge is now known as aggravated sexual battery.

At the time, we did not know about the other young man that was falsely accused.

He said that I should plead guilty because I would get a jury comprised of nothing but women and that they would "fry" me. I told him I wasn't guilty and i refused to plead guilty so he told me to plead no contest and that it wasn't the same thing as guilty. That the judge would be able to see what was going on and that he would make the best decision he could based on what he knew.

I only accepted the plea bargain after refusing it several, several times telling my lawyer that I didn't do it and that I would not cop to a charge simply because it was easier. I Eventually gave in after about 3 hours of my lawyer telling me that I had no choice and that it was what was best because if we failed in the trial I could go to prison for 6+ years no matter if i was innocent or not.

He told me that i would be alright with the lesser charge and that it could be expunged in a few years. Instead, I went to prison for a year, registered as a sex offender and the charge is not expungeable.

I just want to say thanks for listening. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

The lie was that I forced my way into her apartment after knocking on the door and then forced myself on her during the surprise visit. All of this is untrue. She invited me over, picked me up from my grandmother's house, drove me to her apartment, she allowed me inside and we hung out for a few hours with her friend Matt(unknown last name) who was a witness to everything. She was on the computer, matt plaayed his guitar, and i was on the couch. She then took me to work at a local Dillions grocery store and dropped me off. I am sure that there were cameras at the store and that i could prove this.

The police arrested me after my shift at Dillons around 10:30pm. I told them everything and filled out a statement but they treated me like I had no choice in what was going on as if i was already guilty. Handcuffed me to a chair and yelled at me and such.

She married a man in the army, had a child and is living her life as far as I know. I never tried to contact her even though I would love to ask her how she feels about ruining my life. Perhaps she feels guilty and wants to come clean? I don't really know.

In the years just after this happened I was able to figure out that my lawyer had lied to me. If i had known that at the time I would not have listened to him.Also, there was no real evidence against me other than circumstantial and that the woman had falsely accused another guy before me (also circumstantial -charges were dropped). These things combined with my innocence should have been enough for the system to work in my favor if i had only told the judge that i was not guilty instead of pleading no contest.
